title: cardamine laciniata f. minor
intro: Cardamine laciniata f. minor, commonly known as lesser bittercress, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is a perennial herb native to Europe, with its leaves and stems being edible and rich in nutrients. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and have antimicrobial properties. Lesser bittercress contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glucosinolates, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
